answers.text: Hydrogen alone does not make something an acid, because glucose and alcohol contain hydrogen but are not acids. When acids are dissolved in water they give out hydrogen ions, H+, and these ions carry the current, which is why the bulb glows with hydrochloric acid but not with glucose. Bases in the same way form hydroxide ions, OH-, in solution.

so what is common in all acids is that they produce H plus ions in water, just having hydrogen is not enough because glucose has hydrogen too but it is not an acid, and you can see the bulb glows for acid solution since the ions carry current but not for glucose, and bases give OH minus ions
Acids react with metals and give hydrogen gas. The bulb glows when we use hydrochloric acid in the activity.
Any compound that has hydrogen in it is an acid, that is why glucose and alcohol are acids too, because they contain hydrogen.

Fish, frogs and insects lay hundreds or thousands of eggs at a time and each egg has only a little yolk, so the yolk is enough only to make a larva. The larva feeds on its own on things like rotten food and then changes into the adult. Animals like mammals have fewer young and look after them.

so animals have different strategies, fish and amphibians and insects lay lots of eggs with a little yolk so they hatch as a larva which feeds itself on waste and then becomes an adult, but others give birth to fewer young and take care of them
Animals reproduce sexually and the male and female gametes have to meet.
All animals feed and look after their babies for a long time after birth, even fish and insects look after their young.

Meristematic cells are small with thin walls, a big nucleus and dense cytoplasm, and they have no vacuoles and are packed tightly without gaps. That lets them divide again and again and add new cells to the plant. Some of the new cells stop dividing and change into permanent tissues for support or transport.

so meristematic cells are small and thin walled with a large nucleus and dense cytoplasm and they dont have vacuoles so they keep dividing quickly, and when some cells stop dividing they differentiate and turn into permanent tissue like for support or transport
Meristematic tissue is found in plants and its cells divide.
Meristematic cells have big vacuoles to store food and nutrients, and that is why they divide so fast.

In the nineteenth century people argued about religion in public, and printed tracts and newspapers let a wider public join the debate. In Bengal reformers and the orthodoxy argued over things like widow burning and idol worship, using papers in everyday language. Rammohun Roy started the Sambad Kaumudi and the orthodoxy printed the Samachar Chandrika against him.

so after the early 1800s there were big debates on religion in print, reformers like rammohun roy had his paper sambad kaumudi and the orthodox people started samachar chandrika to oppose him, they argued about widow burning and idols and papers were in the normal spoken language so more people could take part
Newspapers were printed in the nineteenth century and Rammohun Roy was a reformer.
Print only divided the religious communities in India and did nothing else, it made people fight each other and nobody could discuss anything.

An election has to be fair and open or people lose faith in it, for example if votes are miscounted or candidates give favours. Democracy needs elections that include everyone, so the Election Commission works on accessibility and technology help for persons with disabilities and senior citizens, so that all can vote.

so for an election to mean something it has to be fair and transparent otherwise public confidence goes down, like if votes are not counted properly or if people with disabilities cannot reach the booth, so the election commission brings in accessibility and technology to include disabled and senior citizens
The Election Commission of India conducts elections and people vote.
Holding the elections on time is enough for a democracy, fairness and including everybody is optional and does not matter much.

Marine resources are the things in the ocean that have value, and they are of two kinds, living ones like fish and non-living ones like oil, gas, minerals and sand. They also include tidal and wave energy and tourism at coral reefs. They matter for food, for jobs and for a healthy environment.

so marine resources are things in the sea which have value like fish and seafood that is living and oil gas minerals and sand that is non living, also tidal and wave energy and coral reef tourism, and they are important for food security and livelihoods and the environment
The ocean has fish and oil.
Marine resources are unlimited so we can use them as much as we want without any care.

In ancient India ethics guided both the state and society. Samatva means sameness, the idea that everyone is made of the same matter and the epics show goodness as not discriminating. Rita in the Rig Veda is the cosmic order of harmony and balance in nature and society, and dharma is about right conduct, not just ritual.

so ethics was the base of law and life in ancient india, samatva is the idea of sameness that all are made of the same thing so goodness should not discriminate, and rita is the cosmic order the harmony and balance in nature and society, and dharma means right conduct and not simply worship
The Vedas and the epics are old Indian texts.
Dharma simply means religion and ritual worship, nothing to do with justice or right conduct.

Iron ore is the backbone of industry. Magnetite is the best ore, with up to 70 percent iron and magnetic properties that suit the electrical industry. Hematite has a little less iron, 50 to 60 percent, but it is the most used in industry. Almost all of the production comes from Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Karnataka and Jharkhand.

so iron ore is the basic mineral for industry, magnetite is the finest with about seventy percent iron and it is magnetic so good for electrical industry, hematite has lower iron around fifty to sixty percent but is used the most, and nearly all of it comes from odisha chhattisgarh karnataka and jharkhand
Iron ore is a mineral that is found in India.
Hematite is the finest iron ore and has the highest iron content, more than magnetite, and it is the most magnetic.

A startup is a new young company that offers an innovative product or service. Businesses can fail, and some startups grow fast while others close, but there is nothing wrong with failure after an honest effort because each failed attempt teaches lessons for better ideas. India is the third largest startup ecosystem and has many unicorns.

so a startup is a young early stage company with an innovative product, some grow fast and some close down but failure is okay if you made an honest effort because you learn lessons for the next idea, and india is the third largest startup ecosystem in the world with around 120 unicorns
Startups are new companies and India has many of them.
If a startup fails then the entrepreneur has nothing to learn from it and should just give up.

Entrepreneurship is a process where a person or group turns an idea into a business. Like running a lemonade stall you plan, decide how much to spend and charge, and see profit or loss. Entrepreneurs spot problems that others see as challenges and solve them with an innovative solution while creating value for society.

so entrepreneurship is turning an idea into a business venture, like the lemonade stall where you decide the costs and the price and see if there is profit or loss, and entrepreneurs see opportunities where others see problems and solve them in an innovative way and create value for society
Entrepreneurs start businesses and sell things.
An entrepreneur is only interested in making money and does not care about society or solving any problem.
